generations.zh: 当前代。754B MoE（激活数未公开）+ 321B Flash 杯；官方口径「open-weights 里编码最强」。
generations.en: Current generation. 754B MoE (activation not disclosed) plus a 321B Flash tier; officially billed as the strongest open-weights coder.

generations.zh: 同代中期两次迭代；5.2 的代码基准是 5.3 官方改进幅度的对照（「50% improvement over GLM-5.2」）。
generations.en: Two mid-generation refreshes; GLM-5.2 is the reference point for the official 5.3 improvement claim ("50% improvement over GLM-5.2").

generations.zh: 本代起点，同月发布 FP8 变体。
generations.en: Generation opener, with an FP8 variant released the same month.

generations.zh: 上一代 Flash 杯，MIT 许可的小杯路线。
generations.en: Previous-generation Flash tier, continuing the small MIT-licensed line.

sizeTiers.zh: 小杯 Flash：MIT 许可，本地部署优先选它
sizeTiers.en: Flash tier: MIT-licensed, the first choice for local deployment

sizeTiers.zh: 大杯 5.3：754B MoE，服务器级；许可以为发布页原文为准
sizeTiers.en: Flagship 5.3: 754B MoE, server-class; licence per the release page

licenses.zh: other · license_name: glm-5.3（大杯，以发布页原文为准）
licenses.en: other · license_name: glm-5.3 (flagship; see the release page)

claims.zh: 官方 README 自评：「GLM-5.3 is the most capable open-weights model for coding, with a 50% improvement over GLM-5.2 on our in-house Z.ai Code Bench」——「本站口径」风险点：这是厂商自评基准，不是第三方横评。
claims.en: Official README self-assessment: "GLM-5.3 is the most capable open-weights model for coding, with a 50% improvement over GLM-5.2 on our in-house Z.ai Code Bench" — note this is a vendor-run benchmark, not third-party evaluation.

claims.zh: 官方 config：max_position_embeddings = 1,048,576（1M 上下文）；官方 README 的 NL2Repo 评测在 1M 上下文下进行。
claims.en: Official config: max_position_embeddings = 1,048,576 (1M context); the README's NL2Repo evaluation ran under 1M context.

positioning.zh: 中文 agent 与代码强项、迭代节奏极快（半年四代）。大杯与 Flash 杯许可不同——本地部署优先 MIT 的 Flash 杯。本站收录的 glm-5 系列在 GLM-5.3 上。
positioning.en: Strong at Chinese agentic work and code, with a very fast iteration cadence. Flagship and Flash tiers carry different licences — for local deployment, prefer the MIT Flash tier. This site's glm-5 series tracks GLM-5.3.

onSite.zh: 本站已收录 GLM-5.3 的量化对比（2 个模型仓 / 21 个量化档）
onSite.en: This site covers GLM-5.3 quantisations (2 repos / 21 tiers)
